_README: UI chrome for the SC Mining Material Finder 2.0.
Scope: interface only -- tabs, buttons, labels, headings, presets, cart.
The tool's long-form SEO article and FAQ (~7,400 chars across 14 blocks) are
deliberately NOT here yet. They sit inside the iframe, so they rank for the
github.io tool page rather than citizen-starter-guide.com, which makes them a
separate objective. The runtime picks up whatever is in this file, so adding
Material names (Agricium, Bexalite, Quantainium...), location names
(Aberdeen, Daymar, Lyria...) and system names come from CIG's own glossary at
build time -- they are NOT listed here.
STATUS: German reviewed most closely. FR/JA/ZH authored but UNVERIFIED by a

Astronomical designations (Lagrange A-G, Pyro Belt/Pyro V-x, Yela Asteroid Belt, Aaron Halo...) and the referral code are in never_translate: they are proper nouns in every language, and listing them keeps the runtime's missing-strings report free of non-gaps.
